title: Percentages and fraction conversions: practice set
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: What is 3/16 expressed as a percentage?
Find the value of 35% of 240 plus 12% of 150.
The price of an article goes up from ₹400 to ₹470. What is the percentage increase?
In a class, 60% of the students are girls. There are 28 boys. How many students are in the class?
A is 25% more than B. B is what percent less than A?

The population of a town grew by 10% in the first year and by 20% in the second year. After two years it is 15,840. What was the population at the start?
A party's vote share rose from 40% to 46%. Let p be the rise in percentage points and r the percentage increase in its vote share. Find p + r.
In an exam, 80% of the candidates passed Quant, 70% passed Verbal, and 15% failed both. What percent passed both?
The price of an article goes up 20%, then falls 25%, and then rises by r% so that it returns to the original price. Find r to two decimal places.
